decision: Replace the PeeringDB facility point with the IBGE CNEFE 2022 coordinate of Rua Engenheiro Afonso Cavalcanti 100, Bela Vista, Porto Alegre, the POA1 address a federal court published in the Diário Oficial da União.
conversion: None: LONGITUDE and LATITUDE copied as published (6 decimals). The file states no datum; IBGE uses SIRGAS 2000, which coincides with WGS84 well below a metre.

containment_checks.street_records: CNEFE has 81 records on Rua Engenheiro Afonso Cavalcanti (all CEP 90440-110, Bela Vista) at numbers 31, 41, 51, 54, 93, 100, 135, 161, 233, 250, 270, 281 and 325; number 100 has exactly one record (96447237), the only record at its coordinate. Nearest other numbers to it: 54 (17.7 m, an establishment labelled EMPRESA DE CONSULTORIA), 233 (23.1 m, an establishment labelled EMPRESA DE TELECOMUNICACOES EMBRATEL) and 250 (37.6 m).
containment_checks.name_search: No CNEFE record in Porto Alegre has an establishment label containing ELEA, DATA CENTER or DATACENTER.
containment_checks.replaced_point: The replaced point (-51.1911, -30.034458) lies 122.7 m west along the same street, about 50 m from the coordinates of numbers 41 and 51.

identity_bridge: Diário Oficial da União, 10 July 2024, page 203: a TRF4 contract extract requires the court's links and equipment to be installed at 'Rua Engenheiro Afonso Cavalcanti, 100 - Bela Vista, Porto Alegre (CAGE TRF4 no Datacenter POA1 - ELEA DIGITAL)' (text read with pdftotext from the capture already in the Atlas archive, sha256 a1a399e0...). Elea's POA1 page places POA1 in Bela Vista.
caveat: The census labelled the single establishment at number 100 'LOJA OI' (an Oi shop), not Elea, and enumeration (2022-2023) predates the gazette extract; the tie rests on the government-published street and number.
nearby_records_within_2km: Only this site (curated:elea-poa1-porto-alegre, 123 m) in the current dataset; no pending queue addition or locator correction within 2 km. Earlier holds for Elea POA1 (thirtyfourth, fortyninth, br-p1) asked for an official address or parcel record; this correction supplies one.
not_used: PeeringDB, commercial map services and map links were not used.
